# American Academy of Actuaries

> Professional association serving 20,000 actuaries with standards, resources, and policy expertise across health, life, casualty, retirement, and risk management practice areas.

The American Academy of Actuaries (Actuary.org) is the primary professional body for U.S. actuaries, providing qualification standards, professional conduct guidelines, continuing education, and actuarial research. The organization maintains rigorous standards through the Actuarial Standards Board (ASB) and enforces professional discipline through the Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline.

## Key Topics

- Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)
- U.S. Qualification Standards
- Code of Professional Conduct
- Actuarial Standards Board (ASB)
- Academy Learning
- Academy Connect
- Health Insurance Practice
- Life Insurance Practice
- Casualty Insurance Practice
- Retirement & Pension Practice
- Risk Management & Financial Reporting
- Continuing Education
- Professional Development
- Regulatory Guidance
- Policy Research

## Professional Standards & Ethics

- [Professionalism](https://actuary.org/professionalism): Professional standards, ethics, and qualification standards for actuaries.
- [Code of Conduct](https://actuary.org/professionalism/code-of-conduct): Professional code of conduct and ethics guidelines for actuaries.
- [Actuarial Standards of Practice](https://actuary.org/professionalism/actuarial-standards-of-practice): ASOP guidelines and standards for actuarial professional practice.
- [U.S. Qualification Standards](https://actuary.org/professionalism/us-qualification-standards): U.S. qualification standards and continuing education requirements.
- [Actuarial Board for Counseling and Discipline](https://actuary.org/professionalism/actuarial-board-of-counseling-and-discipline): Board providing guidance, complaints handling, and discipline oversight.
- [Public Discipline](https://actuary.org/professionalism/public-discipline): Public record of disciplinary actions and professional conduct violations.

## Practice Areas

- [Health Insurance Practice](https://actuary.org/practice-area/health): Health insurance practice area covering ACA, Medicare, Medicaid, and reform.
- [Life Insurance Practice](https://actuary.org/practice-area/life): Life insurance practice area covering reserves, capital, and annuity products.
- [Casualty Insurance Practice](https://actuary.org/practice-area/casualty): Casualty insurance practice area covering property, cyber, and workers' comp.
- [Retirement Practice](https://actuary.org/practice-area/retirement): Retirement practice area covering pensions, Social Security, and policy.
- [Risk Management & Financial Reporting](https://actuary.org/practice-area/risk-management-financial-reporting): Risk management and financial reporting practice with data science tools.

## Policy & Research

- [Policy & Research](https://actuary.org/policy-research): Policy research and actuarial expertise across health, life, casualty, and retirement.
- [Research](https://actuary.org/policy-research/research): Actuarial research papers on insurance, climate risk, and financial stability.

## Resources & Learning

- [Resource Center](https://actuary.org/resource-center): Library of actuarial practice resources, policy research, and regulatory guidance.
- [Event Calendar](https://actuary.org/calendar): Calendar of actuarial events, webinars, seminars, and continuing education.
- [Newsroom](https://actuary.org/newsroom): Press releases and announcements from the American Academy of Actuaries.

## Member Portal & Account

- [Member Login](https://actuary.org/member-login): Authentication page for member account access and membership portal.
- [Member Overview](https://actuary.org/member-overview): Member portal access for Academy Learning, Connect, and account management.

## Optional

- [Potentially Disruptive Events](https://actuary.org/membership/volunteer-center/potentially-disruptive-events): Volunteer resources and risk management for disruptive events.
